Identified as this saint because: Commons titles the plate «Акепсим, Иосиф и Аифал» — Acepsimas, Joseph and Aeithalas — in the illustrated Lives of the Saints of 1903-1911. That triad is kept together on 3 November, which is this folder's Greek feast, and the Acepsimas of it is the bishop martyred in Persia. He is shown with the other two, not alone.
